$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFDT (AIP France, chart dated 2024-01-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart for the notes, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.
name: Tarbes - Laloubère

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both grass strips prohibited.
All TKOF or LDG is suspended when a glider is immobilized on the half side of the glider RWY at less than a half width of the common limit.
Pilots must check that their ACFT performance allows the overflight of the road "RD 935" located near THR 08 with a margin of at least 50 ft.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Close attention is advised due to possible glider activity to select the fitted QFU.
Not home-based pilots must consult special temporary instructions on the website www.aerobigorre.org/infopilote and register on it.
The registration is valid for 12 months and must be reregistered in case of changes in these instructions.
QFU 080° ARR and QFU 260° DEP: without entry clearance in CTR LOURDES, stay East of the Odos water tower visual reference point.
Recommanded caution considering the proximity of CTR LOURDES and TMA 1 PYRENEES in order to avoid any entry in class D airspace without clearance.
Possible parachuting on AD (n°330), avoid airfield overhead depending on real activity known on Pyrénées Info.
QFU in use on request dropping aircraft pilot or dropping ground base.
0800-SS (SUM: - 1 HR) - PPR PYRENEES APP.
PJE (NR 334-1) TARBES QUARTIER LARREY - FL 120 - SR-SS except SAT, SUN and Public HOL - Activity according to protocol - Actual activity known on PYRENEES INFO.
PJE (NR 334-2) TARBES QUARTIER SOULT - FL 115
SR-SS except SAT, SUN and Public HOL - Activity according to protocol - Actual activity known on PYRENEES INFO.
AEM (NR 9066): HJ, 330 ft ASFC.
ULM: entry within ACFT circuit.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes adjacentes interdite.
Tout TKOF ou LDG d'ACFT est suspendu si un planeur est immobilisé sur la piste planeurs à moins d'une demilargeur de la limite commune des pistes.

L'attention des pilotes est attirée sur la nécessité de vérifier que les performances de leur appareil garantissent le survol de la route RD 935 située à l'extrémité de la piste seuil 08 avec une marge d'au moins 50 ft.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Prudence recommandée compte tenu de l'activité planeur éventuelle dans le choix du QFU.
Les pilotes extérieurs doivent prendre connaissance des consignes particulières temporaires sur le site www.aerobigorre.org/infopilote et s'y inscriront.
L'inscription est valable 12 mois et doit être renouvelée en cas de modification de ces consignes.
ARR QFU 080° et DEP QFU 260° : sans clairance de pénétration en CTR LOURDES, rester à l'Est du repère visuel Château d'eau d'Odos.
Prudence recommandée compte tenu de la proximité des CTR LOURDES et TMA 1 PYRENEES afin d'éviter toute pénétration en espace D sans clairance.
Parachutage possible sur AD (n°330), éviter la verticale en fonction de l'activité réelle connue sur Pyrénées Info.
QFU en service sur intérogation du pilote de l'aéronef de largage ou de la base parachutisme au sol.
